FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Crafted Luggage & Leather Co. specializes in the retail sale of high-quality leather goods and luggage, offering a wide variety of products that cater to both functional and fashion needs. Our operations include sourcing premium materials, ensuring meticulous craftsmanship and quality control, and maintaining an extensive inventory of products ranging from handbags to travel gear. We prioritize excellent customer service, providing personalized shopping experiences while also facilitating online sales through a secure e-commerce platform. Our staff is trained in loss prevention strategies, and we maintain a robust inventory management system to help safeguard against theft and misplacement. With a commitment to environmental responsibility, we ensure that all our operations comply with industry regulations and prioritize sustainable practices. We strive for continual improvement, regularly assessing our practices for efficiency and effectiveness in both our physical and online storefronts.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities and confirms that it maintains strong security measures to prevent theft and vandalism. We have established a comprehensive online sales platform with robust cybersecurity measures in place to ensure the safety of our transactions. Our commitment to security and compliance underpins all aspects of our operations.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurring on 08/15/2023 due to a minor theft incident where $1,500 worth of leather goods were taken from the store. The theft was reported to local authorities, and security measures have since been enhanced. Current status: resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Sunday: 11:00 AM - 6:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty safe, Class 350, UL Listed, bolted to the floor.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with regular monitoring and surveillance cameras in place.
